1491-2033-6218-8320.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4050-4681-5170-8175.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-5470-6495-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-5470-6495-6791.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1870-4873-5087-5793.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4873-5087-5793.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-4873-5087-5793.description:
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

2021-2060-3129-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

280-1479-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

4013-4929-7765.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking The Fantastic Four.
When The Fantastic Four enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

1809-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1809-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Returned Pastcaller and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1809-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

3587-7263.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
3587-7263.description:
Cast Take Up the Shield by paying {1}{W}, targeting Boros Reckoner.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing that much damage to itself and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 3 any number of times.

969-1061-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
969-1061-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
969-1061-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

1510-4574-5147-5849.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4677-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4677-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1651-3875-5921-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-5921-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-3875-5921-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1978-2392-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 3 or greater.
1978-2392-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat

4131-6331-6923.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4131-6331-6923.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}. Relic Putrescence triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 eight additional times, and then repeat step 1 once. This will result in a total of ten Relic Putrescence triggers.
Holding priority, activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, donating Basalt Monolith to an opponent and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve all Relic Putrescence triggers, causing the opponent who controls it to get ten poison counters. They will then lose the game as a state-based action.

3617-4423-4935-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
3617-4423-4935-6886.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

1429-1477-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-1477-4452-5402.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1612-5755.description:
Cast Shard of the Nightbringer by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Shard of the Nightbringer triggers, causing an opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

4050-5660-5714.description:
Cast Servant of the Scale by paying {G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Servant of the Scale, adding {G}.
When Servant of the Scale dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Servant of the Scale from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1379-2043-2320-2556.notablePrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}.
1379-2043-2320-2556.description:
During an opponent's turn, after their upkeep step, activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reset to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to proudce at least {7}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which can be used to activate Urza's ability infinitely and/or cast Reset choosing its other modes.

799-1164-3278-5103.notablePrerequisites:
Narset does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Narset.
You have at least three other cards in exile.
799-1164-3278-5103.description:
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it.
Holding priority, activate Scrabbling Claws by tapping it, causing you to exile Mirror of Fate from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mirror of Fate ability, choosing itself, Karn's Temporal Sundering and three to five other cards, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top, ensuring Karn's Temporal Sundering and Mirror of Fate are the topmost cards.
Declare Narset as an attacker.
Narset triggers, exiling the top four cards of your library and allowing you to cast them from exile this turn without paying their mana costs.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering from exile without paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Cast Mirror of Fate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat each turn.

467-890-1029-4547.notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
467-890-1029-4547.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Tolarian Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to untap Palladium Myr and Shorikai.
Repeat.

2266-3430-4289.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding three snow mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

415-1738.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
415-1738.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Xathrid Demon triggers, causing you to sacrifice Serra Avatar and causing each opponent to lose life equal to Serra Avatar's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

101-618-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
The token copy of Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
